units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 2b:13">B. Bath. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>היזק ר׳ לאו וכ׳</he> the discomfort of being exposed to (a neighbor’s) sight is no claimable damage; <cite ref="Bava Batra 3a:6">ib. 3ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 59b:4">59ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Niddah 31a:29">Nidd. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>רְאִיַּית העיין</he> the faculty of sight.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 9:3">Gen. R. s. 9</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 1:31">Gen. I, 31</cite>) <he>מלך … ר׳ אחת וכ׳</he> when a human king builds a palace, he casts one (examining) glance at the upper stories and another at the lower; <he>אבל … ר׳ אחת</he> but the Lord casts one look at both; <he>העוה״ז … ר׳ אחת</he> with one glance the Lord surveyed this world and the world to come; Yalk. ib. 15 <he>בר׳</he>.
Lam. R. to V, 1 ר׳ מרחוק raah is used for looking from a distance, v. הַבָּטָה; a. fr.—Pl. רְאִיּוֹת, רְאִיּיוֹת.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 3:2">Ex. R. s. 3</cite> (ref. to <he>ראה ראיתי</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 3:7">Ex. III, 7</cite>) <he>ואני רואה שתי ר׳</he>, v. <cite ref="T00011"><he>רָאָה</he></cite>; Tanḥ. Sh’moth 20; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 42:5">Ex. R. s. 42</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zavim 1:1">Zab. I, 1</cite> <he>הרואה ר׳ אחת של זוב</he> he who has had one attack of gonorrhœa.
Ib. 6 מקצת הר׳ מהיום וכ׳ one of the attacks on one day, and another on the day after; a. fr.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Niddah 37b:14">Nidd. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>מטמיא בר׳ כבימים</he> becomes unclean by a certain number of attacks (even if they all be on one day) as well as by a certain number of days.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 24a:1">B. Kam. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>קירבה רְאִיּוֹתֶיהָ</he> if she had her attacks at short intervals; <he>ריחקה ר׳</he> at long intervals; a. e.

senses.gloss: (with ref. to Ex. XXIII, 17) appearance in the Temple, pilgrimage.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 1:1">Ḥag. I, 1</cite> <he>הכל חייבים בר׳ וכ׳</he> all (males) are under obligation to appear in the Temple, except &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 1:2">Ib. 2</cite> <he>הר׳ מעה כסף</he> the pilgrim’s burnt-offering must be worth a m’ʿah of silver (v. <cite ref="T00018"><he>רֵאָיוֹן</he></cite>).

Ib. 7ᵃ (ref. to ראיון, Peah I, 1) רְאִיַּית פנים בעזרה it means the appearance in the Temple (has no limits, you may visit the Temple during the festive season as often as you desire); (another opinion) ראיית פנים בקרבן it means the visit connected with a sacrifice (and you must offer a sacrifice as often as you appear); Y. Peah I, 15ᵃ bot. [read:] מתניתן בר׳ פנים אבל ר׳ קרבן יש לה שיעור the Mishnah in saying that reayon has no limits refers to the number of appearances, but as regards the visit attended with sacrifice, it has a limit (as to the minimum value of the sacrifice).

<cite ref="Chagigah 6a:11">Ḥag. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>עולה … עולת ר׳ הואי</he> the burnt-offering which the Israelites brought in the desert (<cite ref="Exodus 24:15">Ex. XXIV, 15</cite>) was the offering of appearance before God; a. fr.
